name: zmodel_matlbuffer_release_all_active
description: zModel_MatlBuffer::ReleaseAllActive releases active material slots until the active list is empty, clears the reuse cache, and returns zero.
known_limits: Tier C only; no accepted VC COFF byte comparison exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The function is verified as a caller-level material-pool loop; individual slot cleanup behavior is covered by zmodel_matl_slot_release.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x480d80 has no current warnings and validates the loop over g_zModel_MatlActiveHeadIndex, repeated calls to zModel_MatlSlot::Release, g_zModel_MatlReuseCache clear, and zero return.
The dependency frontier for 0x480d80 reports no visible source blockers, and its only direct callee zModel_MatlSlot::Release is functionally accepted by target zmodel_matl_slot_release.

Native smoke zmodel_matlbuffer_release_all_active_smoke verifies a three-slot active chain is fully released, active head becomes -1, all released slots move to the free list in release order, in-use count reaches zero, material payloads are cleared, the reuse cache is cleared, and the return value is zero.
